message: I remember the time the power went out right in the middle of my favorite cooking show. I thought I was ready with a couple of flashlights, but I’d forgotten to charge my power bank. Cue me rummaging through drawers, trying to find batteries for my lantern, only to realize I used the last ones in the remote! In the end, I made a lovely dinner by candlelight—oh wait, no candles! Just my trusty old flashlight and a whole lot of improvisation. Lesson learned: a little prep goes a long way, especially when it comes to staying comfy during a blackout. What’s your go-to strategy for unexpected outages?
